From camps around Flagstaff they drill as one people and speak of a returning Caesar who will impose Roman order on Arizona. The host calls itself Caesar's Legion, and each day more recruits join its march.

Cohorts have secured the  roads, scouts roam toward the great Colorado, and Caesar has proclaimed that the city will become the first stronghold of a new Roman order. The rulers of Arizona must now meet the Legion in battle.

You are reading the history of one of the oldest empires in the world - the Roman Empire. The names of the ancient rulers mean almost nothing to you, but the story of one of the ancient emperors, Caesar, amazed you to the depths of your soul. The more you learn about him, about his accomplishments, conquests and politics, the more you admire him. It is certanly, that ordinary mortal could not do what Caesar did in his time.
There is no doubt that Caesar is a God!
True to Caesar!

Should I use my authority as a ruler to establish new Cult of Caesar quickly, or gain support in the shadows before revealing a new teaching to the world?
I am the ruler. They are obliged to obey.

The Third Rome

Long ago, the lands of Russia were united under the rule of Caesar, whose name was eventually distorted to "Tsar". These were blessed times, blessed by the spirit of Pax Romana, but the coming of the Crucified God and the Event brought grief and suffering to this land. But finally, the scattered lands of Russia are united again under a single flag - the flag of the revived Roman Empire. [Root.GetDynName] was crowned in Moscow, otherwise referred to as the Tertia Roma, as the [Root.GetTitle] of Rome. This marks the beginning of a Great New Era for Russia!

Long ago, in antediluvian times, Russia assumed the title of the Third Rome, becoming a bastion of Christianity instead of the Second Rome - Byzantium, destroyed by the Turkish barbarians. For centuries, the Third Rome has kept Christian traditions, but the Event have destroyed the Third Rome and brought grief and suffering to this land. But finally, after many years, the scattered lands of Russia are united once again under a single flag - the flag of the revived Roman Empire. [Root.GetDynName] was crowned in Moscow, otherwise referred to as the Tertia Roma, as the [Root.GetTitle] of Rome. This marks the beginning of a Great New Era for Russia!

Before the rise of The Legion and its mighty Caesar, the lands of the South West laid scattered and squabaling between petty tribes and nomads. Now, by the Glory of Mars the Red Banners of the Legion flutter triumphantly in the desert sun. The city formerly known as Las Vegas, now the Shining Jewel of the Wastes, Nova Roma, stands as the heart of the Legion. With their victory comes a new proclomation from Caesar, the wastes will all come under Pax Nova Romana!

For centuries, the lands of Italy were divided between warring principalities, city-states and small kingdoms, while the true past of this land remained forgotten among the ruins of the Eternal City. But finally, by the will of the Lord, the greatest of the states of antiquity was finally restored, and [Root.GetDynName] was crowned as [Root.GetTitle] of the restored Roman Empire in the city of Rome. Pax Romana has finally returned to the lands of Italy!

The Caesar's Ascension

The Festival of the Ascension of Caesar is a festival held in March. According to legend, after the thrice-cursed traitor Brutus killed Caesar, on the tenth day after Octavianus, together with the Triumvirs, defeated the traitor, Caesar rose from the dead and blessed Octavianus to rule, after which Caesar ascended to Olympus to join the gods. During this holiday, the faithful Caesarians offer prayers to the gods, arrange magnificent feasts, and in the evening they burn the effigy symbolizing Brutus.
Happy Ascension!
The Great Triumph

The Great Triumph is a celebration held in May. According to legend, in May, the troops of the Third Rome, led by the reborn Caesar Josefus Julius Ferrat, known among the Stalinists as Lord Stalin, managed to defeat the horde of germanic barbarians who came from the west. On this day, legionnaires hold military parades and lay flowers at the sanctuaries of the spirits of their fallen brothers.
Glory to Third Rome!
Belisarius Day

Belisarius Day is a holiday dedicated to one of the incarnations of the Divine Caesar - Flavius Belisarius. According to legend, Belisarius managed to conquer vast territories of Rome from the godless barbarians, conquering Africa, Italy and Persia. On this day, spectacular theatrical performances are held dedicated to the numerous victories of Belisarius over the Germans, Turks, Berbers, Persians and other barbarian peoples.
Glory to Rome!
The Romanization

After a few months of occupation, the Legion have setup their new stronghold. Having conquered the first city in their way, they immediately began the process of romanizing the local population. As the locals have come to accept Caesar as their ruler and Mars as their god, the process comes to fruition. The first steps in building a new Rome have begun.
We bring them civilization.

The Caesar in Heavens demands it!
Perhaps later...

Our legionnaires successfully "romanized" one of the tribal settlement of local barbarians. Most of the local population was taken into slavery, some were killed while trying to resist, some, mostly young men, were forcibly recruited into the army and sent to distant garrisons, where they would be taught roman culture and discipline.
Good.
Collegium Pontificum Created

Until now, the cultists of Mars had no supreme religious leader, and the rites created at the dawn of the faith had begun to drift apart. To preserve the true teachings, the College of Pontiffs has been established at the Temple of Goodsprings outside Las Vegas. The temple and the office of Pontifex Maximus have been entrusted to a high priest charged with guarding the unity and purity of the Cult of Mars.

Until now, the cultists of Pompeius did not have a supreme leader of the church, and as a result, the religious practices and rituals created at the dawn of the Cult of Pompeius were distorted, just like the views regarding the nature of Pompeius divinity and his place among the gods. Therefore, the College of Pontiffs was created, a council of high priests headed by the Great Pontiff, who will monitor the purity of the Cult and protect it from internal and external dangers.
In the Pompeius name!
This is not concern of ours...
Interesting...
The Praetorian Guard

From time immemorial, the Praetorian Guard, an elite cohort of Rome's finest warriors, guarded the incarnations of the Reborn Caesar until it was disbanded after the desctruction of the Empire. But millennia later, the Praetorian Guard was created again in order to guard the Cult of Mars and the future incarnations of the Reborn Caesar against heretics and infidels.

Now that the Roman Empire has been restored, it is necessary to decide what to do with Caesar's Legion. The Legion has fulfilled its task of conquering the lost lands of Rome and is no longer needed by the restored empire, but it still remains a significant force, which can definitely come in handy in the future. There are two options: the first - we can disband the Legion, and the second option - we can reform it into a new Imperial Army, which will guard the borders and the emperor. What should be done?
Fate of the Legion
Reform this, the Legion may still be useful to us

After the restoration of the Roman Empire, a new Imperial Legion was created - a professional army that will henceforth protect the Pax Romana and the Roman emperors from all possible external enemies. A solemn parade was held in the capital, and the Roman augurs made abundant sacrifices to the gods and the Divine Caesar. The Roman Empire have became even more dangerous.

Ever since Roman rule was established over Stalingrad, there have been controversies among the priests regarding the goddess of Mother Russia, whose gigantic statue stands in this province. Some priests claim that Mother Russia is a barbarian goddess who is not part of the Pax Romana, other priests claim that Mother Russia is the patroness and protector of the Third Rome. Should Mother Russia be recognized as part of the Roman pantheon?
Mother Russia will become part of the Roman pantheon!
Mother Russia is a barbarian goddess!

Once upon a time, even before the Event, Rome, the Eternal City, ruled the entire known world. But when the hordes of barbarians conquered the Eternal City and the priest of the Crucified God reigned in the Rome, the Empire was destroyed. Deprived of Pax Romana, the world fell into disarray, which soon led to the Event. But finally, after millennia, the high priest of the Crucified God was finally expelled from the Eternal City, and a new Roman Republic was proclaimed in the Rome. Pax Romana has finally returned to the lands of Italy!
Salt Lake City, the Third Rome

After a long campaign north from the Mojave, Caesar's cohorts have won Salt Lake City. Legionaries forced the approaches, broke the defending line around the old temple district, and secured the roads and waterways beside the Great Salt Lake. Caesar has named the city the Third Rome of the Legion: a northern bastion commanding the routes between the desert, the Rockies, and the interior.
The Third Rome secures the northern road.
Las Vegas, the First Rome

Caesar's Legion has prevailed in the battle for Las Vegas. After a hard march across the Mojave, the cohorts captured the wells, road junctions, and old pleasure palaces that dominate the city. Standards now line the Strip while engineers fortify its approaches. Caesar proclaims Las Vegas the First Rome of the Legion, its political heart and western seat of command.
The First Rome belongs to the Legion.
Los Angeles, the Second Rome

After weeks of fighting through the basin, Caesar's Legion has won Los Angeles. The cohorts secured the mountain passes, civic center, and roads leading to the Pacific, compelling the remaining garrisons to surrender. From this great western metropolis the Legion can command the coast, and Caesar names it the Second Rome: a rival seat of power facing the ocean.
The Second Rome rises on the Pacific.

The Fall of Britannia

In antediluvian times, Divine Caesar, having conquered Gaul, crossed the Strait of Dover in order to conquer Britain. In a great battle, Divine Caesar defeated Queen Boudicca and since then Britain has been under the rule of Rome. But when Rome fell, the British, rejecting Pax Romana, became proud and proclaimed their own empire, worshiping their Queen as a deity. The arrogant islanders conquered and enslaved entire continents, and at one time proclaimed themselves "The Empire over which the sun does not set", but now London is on fire, for, after many centuries, Rome have finally returned to the British Isles. Divine Caesar has once again defeated the Queen, and Aquila banners now flutter over the ancient tower of Big Ben.

But now Bhutan is in ruins, as its supposedly indestructible armies were destroyed by the countless legions of Rome. Roman officials are already sorting, packing and sending caravans laden with trophies, found in the undeground cities, to the capital, and the administrators appointed here are already finalizing the official annexation of the new province of Butania to the Empire.

Thousands of years later, the German Confederation might well have defeated the legions of a reborn Roman Empire - but it failed. The few who survived the defeat of the armies of the German Confederation were taken into slavery or crucified in the Teutoburg Forest, as a symbolic revenge for the ancient defeat.
